name: New Roots
tagline: Simplifies immigration eligibility by reading scattered government pages into one clear assessment.

awards: Most Impactful Use of the X API by X

problem: Immigration information is scattered and jargon-heavy, so applicants waste money and time, as a teammate's family experienced.
solution: Scrapes government sources and uses AI to assess eligibility and explain requirements in plain language.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter your profile and see which visas you qualify for.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Impactful Use of the X API by X” among 195 submissions.
Validated through a family member's visa application.

lessons: Personal bureaucratic pain is a strong civic-tech opener.
